run_backfill_all_datasets: run backfill for all datasets in the database and delete non-supported ones
run_backfill_retryable_errors: run backfill for datasets that have retryable errors in the cache
run_backfill_datasets: run parallel backfill for a set of dataset names using a thread pool executor
run_try_backfill_dataset: run backfill for a single dataset and return statistics or handle exceptions gracefully
summarize_BackfillStatistics: summarize the BackfillStatistics dataclass that tracks analyzed, error, and operation counts
